sources.claim: Fixed enhanced Frenzy refreshing without its longer duration; does not specify the numeric enhanced refresh duration.

content_policies: Contact window is reset by each eligible damage receipt; windup starts at first contact and is never reset by further contacts.
Contact expiry removes windup. Windup expiry activates only while the matching contact instance is still live, including at identical timestamps.
Initial seven seconds start at activation time, not at the last damage receipt. This sampling interpretation needs independent verification.

While active, eligible damage refreshes the active buff without rebuilding a 12-second windup; self-damage, missing actor/victim, environmental_damage-tagged damage and non-positive loss are excluded.

Positive HP, absorption or Chorus shield loss involving the owner counts, including damage from another weapon or ability. Environmental attribution and friendly-fire exceptions need further calibration.
Damage contributions apply to same-instance weapon_damage; this template does not copy Kill Clip-specific explosive-perk exclusions. Host tags define damage credit.
Stow keeps timers; detach clears all three buff types. Missing source references are not treated as existing actors; presence checks do not assert world entity liveness.
